title: Zaho Zay
synopsis: A young woman works as a guard in a hopelessly overcrowded Malagasy prison. In her imagination, her absent father — who killed his own brother before she was born — becomes a mythical wandering figure. When a new prisoner arrives claiming to know him, fantasy and reality begin to converge. Co-directed by Maéva Ranaïvojaona and Georg Tiller, with a script by Jean-Luc Raharimanana, Zaho Zay is a hybrid essay-documentary that weaves prison footage, folk myth, and lyric imagery into a meditation on abandonment, justice, and the structures of poverty and violence. The title — it's me in Malagasy — echoes the call inmates make during morning assembly. It broadcast on Arte in 2023.
